title: Aiea Bowl

services.name: Bowling
services.desc: Monday through Thursday, we bring the best in Classic Bowling! Family-friendly with bumper features, HyperBowling Technology, Top 40s songs playing over the speakers, and bowling balls as low as 6-lbs! Socks are not included or provided by Aiea Bowl. They are available to be purchased from our vending machine for $5 per pair. Get the best of both worlds by combining classic bowling fun with upgraded, premium seating! Designed for comfort and a more elevated experience, you and your group can spend your time with us in plush, lounge-style seats! Perfect for groups, parties, or just a special night out. You will be charged based on the rate at which your booking starts. $45 rate applies only
